# Quiz Trail

> Quiz Trail is a free, open-source practice application for Google Cloud AI certifications. PMLE practice is available; Professional Agentic Architect practice is coming soon.

Quiz Trail provides 400+ carefully curated single-choice and multiple-choice practice questions with answer explanations, references, progress tracking, review queues, and section-level insights. It is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

## Public pages

- [Quiz Trail certification catalog](https://quiz-trail.web.app/): Choose a certification. PMLE is available and Professional Agentic Architect is coming soon.
- [Interactive PMLE practice](https://quiz-trail.web.app/practice/): Try ten questions without an account; sign in for the complete question bank and saved progress across devices.
- [10 free PMLE sample questions](https://quiz-trail.web.app/sample-questions/): Preview representative questions, answers, explanations, and official references without signing in.
- [FAQ](https://quiz-trail.web.app/faq/): Sign-in, saved progress, account data, and shared question comments.
- [PMLE FAQ](https://quiz-trail.web.app/pmle/faq/): PMLE question-bank coverage, study approach, and official exam resources.
- [PAA FAQ](https://quiz-trail.web.app/agentic-ai/faq/): Public information about Professional Agentic Architect practice and the private preview.
- [Quiz Trail source code](https://github.com/Ameenota/quiz-trail): Review the open-source project or report an issue.
- [Official Google Cloud certification page](https://cloud.google.com/learn/certification/machine-learning-engineer): Check current certification details and requirements from Google Cloud.

## Access and content notes

- Ten interactive questions, the static sample questions, and the FAQ are public and require no sign-in. The complete interactive bank requires Google sign-in.
- Guest answers and bookmarks last only for the current session. Google sign-in is required only to save progress across devices and read and post shared question comments.
- The practice material is original and curated for learning. It is not an exam dump and does not claim to contain real certification exam questions.
- Learners should use the official Google Cloud certification page and exam guide as the final source for current exam requirements.

- Professional Agentic Architect is in private preview and is not available to general users. PMLE progress and URLs remain unchanged.

- Progress summaries are certification-specific: `/practice/?view=summary` for PMLE and `/practice/?cert=agentic-ai&view=summary` for PAA. The PAA summary requires the authorized preview account.
